original_test_intent: Verify an approved GPU GFX poison/ODECC event produces the specified CPER record and retired bad-page behavior, then verify replay at a recorded bad-page address is rejected as required.
original_method: On the exact dedicated target, preserve baseline identity/health/CPER index/bad pages, run only the approved GFX injection, correlate and securely decode the new CPER, compare bad pages, then run the approved replay attempt at an address selected from the observed list and recover the platform.
manual_activity: AMD/FAE and the platform owner approve the exact destructive injection manifest and dedicated target; an operator monitors console/recovery and the owner adjudicates the correlated evidence.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/OAM/GPU/card/device/block/address mapping and serial identity
Approved amdgpuras GFX poison and ODECC replay commands for the installed firmware/driver/tool versions
Expected Bus-error semantics, bad-page transition and exact CPER field mapping
Verified HTTPS Redfish CPER resource, authentication and protected transfer method
Dedicated-SUT workload drain, recovery/reboot and post-test configuration plan
safety_requirements: Use only a dedicated approved SUT with independent BMC/console recovery and protected data
Do not substitute the source's hardcoded IP/address or invent device/block/address values
Preserve pre-existing logs, CPER and RAS state; do not clear logs/RAS EEPROM or reload drivers unless separately approved
Run each destructive phase once with bounded timeout; stop on unexpected result or health change and never auto-retry
Use verified TLS, structured Redfish parsing, protected credentials and hashed raw attachments
agent_execution_scope: Collect verified read-only identity, health, CPER-index and bad-page baselines
After explicit approval, execute only the supplied GFX command once and capture exact status/output
Acquire/hash/decode the exact new CPER and correlate every required field and bad-page change
After separate approval, execute the supplied replay command against an observed bad-page address once
Recover and collect final health/configuration evidence; make no independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Supply and approve target-specific AMDGPU-RAS commands, expected statuses and field mapping
Approve destructive execution window, dedicated target and recovery disposition
Review command, CPER, bad-page and recovery evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The amdgpuras/CPER workflow is directionally relevant, but DeepSeek adds unauthorized EEPROM/driver changes and the source embeds an unverified device, block and address plus insecure HTTP/text parsing.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use an approved target manifest and secure structured Redfish client to capture baseline, run one bounded GFX injection, hash/decode/correlate the new CPER and bad-page delta, then separately approve one replay attempt at an actually observed address.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both injection phases, CPER +1, OAM/UMC/GC/error-code/severity/poison fields, bad-page comparison, Bus-error/Failed outcomes and 5/10-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL PACKAGE-GATED GPU RAS FAULT INJECTION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind every mutation and artifact to an immutable run manifest containing SUT/OAM/GPU identities, exact commands, tool/firmware versions, timestamps and hashes; correlate the injection output, CPER delta/decode and bad-page lists before replay.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces hardcoded HTTP, grep/index assumptions, malformed SCP examples and fixed replay address with verified resource discovery, secure transfer, observed-address selection and recovery governance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: CPER +1 alone cannot prove the record belongs to this injection, and a larger bad-page list alone cannot prove avoidance; the command/event/location/error fields and replay result must correlate.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fault injection can destabilize GPU, PCIe, firmware or host state and may affect data integrity; no command is safe to infer from a neighboring platform or revision.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define different OEM CPER resources, device/block numbering or expected return semantics; an override must explicitly map them to every retained source criterion rather than deleting coverage.
expected_evidence: Owner/AMD approval and immutable exact GFX/replay command manifest
Raw baseline and after bad-page lists and CPER indexes with timestamps
amdgpuras outputs/exit statuses and new raw CPER attachment hash
Decoded OAM, UMC ext 0 On-die ECC Deferred, GC ext 62 GFX poison consumed correlations
Replay target provenance/result, final recovery/health/configuration and preserved-log/no-auto-retry audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criteria consistently define a two-phase GFX/ODECC workflow. The insecure placeholders and fixed example address are execution defects requiring approved inputs, not contradictory acceptance requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Execution is gated on the AMD/FAE package, target, secure CPER path and recovery approval; those missing project inputs do not prevent this complete static review.

review_improvement: Retains both destructive phases and every specified CPER/bad-page field while eliminating unauthorized setup changes, guessed targets and insecure evidence transport.
independent_technical_reasoning: A monotonically higher CPER ID can include unrelated platform events, so attribution requires timestamps, target identity, injection output and decoded location/type correlation. Likewise, selecting the replay address from the post-injection bad-page list is essential: the source's literal address cannot be reused across devices. The replay 'Failed' criterion is meaningful only after confirming the tool's exact status/exit semantics for the approved version; automation must preserve the raw response for an engineer rather than convert any nonzero exit into a DUT verdict.
